releaseNotes: Live HQ Inventory Stock Visibility: Medical Representatives can now see real-time depot stock indicators (In Stock, Low Stock, Out of Stock) directly on product chips and order forms
Dual Out-of-Stock Notification System: When an order contains low or depleted stock at the HQ depot, both the MR and Headquarter Admin receive immediate alert notifications for rapid replenishment
Admin Order Supervision: Highlights stock shortage warnings and displays item-by-item depot availability directly within the Web Command Center
Crash-Proof Error Boundary: Comprehensive root error boundaries guarantee that unexpected JavaScript exceptions never cause blank white screens
Seamless In-Place Update: Release signing ensures smooth APK update without uninstalling or losing device credentials
